title: Reminder-Answering Lead Days for Refill Item Lists (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
**Allowance.** When the item list of a refill request is worked out in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, an item is listed when its supply runs out no more than the horizon after the request, the horizon being the schedule's ship-window days together with the lead days, and lead days for answering refill reminders are added to that horizon:

- **5 days** for a patient with four or more refill confirmations and no refill decline in the last 6 months;
- **3 days** for a patient with two or more refill confirmations and exactly one refill decline in the last 6 months;
- otherwise none.

## Counting

Refill confirmations and refill declines are the enrollment's refill contacts recorded as confirmed and as declined. A contact is in the last 6 months when its contact date is fewer than 6 whole calendar months before the handling day.

| Confirmations in 6 months | Declines in 6 months | Lead days added |
|---|---|---|
| 4 or more | 0 | 5 |
| 2 or more | exactly 1 | 3 |
| 4 or more | 2 or more | 0 |
| 0 to 3 | 0 | 0 |
| 0 or 1 | 1 | 0 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Five confirmations and no declines in the last 6 months: 5 days.
- Three confirmations and one decline: 3 days.
- Three confirmations and no declines: neither line applies, 0 days.
- Six confirmations and two declines: 0 days.
